hunks.baseline: And that wasn’t all. He had dragged his still-ailing old body into a fight to the death against some unknown son of a bitch.
hunks.sol: And that wasn’t all. He had dragged his still-ailing old body into a fight to the death with some unknown son of a bitch.

hunks.sol: Where was he? Who was he? Why was the ground splitting apart, and why were man-sized boulders raining down on his head?

hunks.sol: Overcome by a sudden wave of profound regret, Jeok Cheongang nearly ascended to immortality on the spot.

hunks.baseline: He had no idea what was happening, but first he had to get himself to safety.
hunks.sol: He had no idea what was going on, but first he had to get out of there.

hunks.baseline: Once his thoughts straightened out, his movements followed with the speed of lightning.
hunks.sol: Once he reached that conclusion, he moved with lightning speed.

hunks.baseline: *First, I need to take care of Taekyung… But who the hell is this old man?*
hunks.sol: *First, I need to get Taekyung… But who the hell is this old man?*

hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang slung the unconscious Jin Taekyung and the Divine Physician over his shoulders, then shot forward.

hunks.sol: His limbs were stiff as stone after so long without moving. He was ravenously hungry and utterly drained.

hunks.baseline: After clashing hands with some monstrous bastard who had crawled out of who-knew-where in this condition, it was only natural for his body to have deteriorated even further. If he had not possessed any internal energy, he would have collapsed long ago.
hunks.sol: In that condition, he had fought some monstrous bastard who had crawled out of who-knew-where. Of course his body had deteriorated even further. If not for his internal energy, he would have collapsed long ago.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, the vibrations grew larger and more violent. Jeok Cheongang gritted his teeth.
hunks.sol: The vibrations suddenly grew even stronger. Jeok Cheongang gritted his teeth.

hunks.baseline: *All right, I get it, so stop rushing me. I’ll get out somehow.*
hunks.sol: *All right, I get it. Stop rushing me. I’ll find a way out.*

hunks.baseline: His grip tightened on the two men. It felt as if some unknown energy had surged from deep within his body.
hunks.sol: His grip tightened on the two men. An unknown strength seemed to surge from somewhere deep within him.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s figure, which had paused for a moment, shot forward as a single streak of flame.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had faltered for a moment, became a streak of flame.

hunks.sol: The interior had been devastated by their battle. All the walls that had once divided the underground prison into a maze had crumbled, leaving behind one vast cavern.

hunks.baseline: As Jeok Cheongang ran forward, using his movement technique, his eyes flashed.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes flashed as he raced forward with his movement technique.

hunks.baseline: Every place had an entrance or exit.
hunks.sol: Every enclosed space had an entrance.

hunks.baseline: At the place where he felt a faint breeze blowing from somewhere, Jeok Cheongang saw the entrance to the underground prison—barely wide enough for one person to pass through.
hunks.sol: He felt a faint breeze coming from somewhere, and when he looked toward it, he saw the entrance to the underground prison—barely wide enough for a single person to pass through.

hunks.baseline: *Hurry, hurry…!*
hunks.sol: *Hurry. Hurry…!*

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang flung himself forward with every ounce of strength he had.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang hurled himself forward with every ounce of strength he had.

hunks.baseline: He stepped across the ground as it turned over beneath him and dodged the rocks falling from overhead.
hunks.sol: He bounded across the heaving ground and dodged the rocks falling from overhead.

hunks.baseline: He passed the corpse of the Heavenly Power Demon, the old man lying dead as though asleep with a peaceful smile on his face, and shot farther and faster.
hunks.sol: He raced past the Heavenly Power Demon’s corpse, the old man lying dead with a peaceful smile as if merely asleep, and pushed himself faster still.

hunks.baseline: Within a short span of time that felt like an eternity, Jeok Cheongang was finally about to take the last step toward the prison entrance.
hunks.sol: The time was brief, yet felt like an eternity. At last, Jeok Cheongang was about to take his final step toward the prison entrance.

hunks.baseline: “Made it…!”
hunks.sol: “Made…!”

hunks.baseline: Rumble! Rumble!
hunks.sol: Rrrrumble! Krrrrrumble!

hunks.baseline: A vibration and roar as loud as—or even louder than—the sum of every tremendous sound that had come before struck all at once.
hunks.sol: A tremor and roar equal to every deafening crash thus far combined—no, greater than all of them—erupted at once.

hunks.baseline: Massive rocks accumulated over hundreds, even thousands, of years crushed down upon the entrance to the underground prison.
hunks.sol: Massive rocks that had accumulated over hundreds, perhaps thousands, of years crashed down over the entrance to the underground prison.

hunks.baseline: And then—
hunks.sol: Then—

hunks.baseline: With an azure dragon’s roar that shook the underground prison, Jeok Cheongang drove his fist, filled with blue-white flames, into the center of the rocks.
hunks.sol: An azure dragon’s roar shook the underground prison as Jeok Cheongang drove his blue-white-flame-wreathed fist into the center of the falling rock.

hunks.baseline: Kwaaang!
hunks.sol: KWAAAANG!

hunks.baseline: The superheated energy contained in the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist smashed and melted the rocks.
hunks.sol: The tremendous heat of the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist shattered and melted the rocks.

hunks.baseline: After a roar that sounded as if the sky itself had split apart, a blast of hot air suddenly swept through the underground prison.
hunks.sol: A roar like the sky splitting apart thundered through the cavern, followed by a sudden blast of scorching wind that swept across the underground prison.

hunks.baseline: “What is this?”
hunks.sol: “What in the world…?”

hunks.baseline: A middle-aged black-clad man who had hurried over after hearing the roar swallowed a groan at the sight before him.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man in black who had hurried over after hearing the roar swallowed a groan at the sight before him.

hunks.baseline: Whoooosh!
hunks.sol: Rrrrrumble!

hunks.baseline: The collapse of nature itself. The cliff hundreds of zhang high behind the Sichuan Tang Clan was slowly sinking down.
hunks.sol: Nature itself was collapsing. The cliff hundreds of zhang tall that loomed behind the Sichuan Tang Clan was slowly sinking into the earth.

hunks.baseline: It was an utterly shocking sight even from more than a hundred zhang away, but there was an even greater problem.
hunks.sol: The sight was staggering even from more than a hundred zhang away, but there was a far greater problem.

hunks.baseline: “D-Deputy Captain. That place is where the Demon Lord is…”
hunks.sol: “D-Deputy Captain. That’s where the Demon Lord is…”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged black-clad man, the deputy captain of Dark Heaven, felt a chill run down his spine at his subordinate’s words.
hunks.sol: A chill ran down the spine of Dark Heaven’s deputy captain.

hunks.baseline: The Western Heaven Demon Lord. If something had happened to him…
hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord. If anything had happened to him…

hunks.baseline: Cold sweat rolled down his forehead. Even when the Sichuan Tang Clan had used Heaven-Shaking Thunder, he had never felt this tense.
hunks.sol: Cold sweat rolled down his forehead. He had not been this nervous even when the Sichuan Tang Clan used Heaven-Shaking Thunder.

hunks.baseline: He gave an urgent order.
hunks.sol: He barked an urgent order.

hunks.baseline: “Gather every brother scattered throughout the area immediately!”
hunks.sol: “Gather every brother scattered across the grounds immediately!”

hunks.baseline: “E-Everyone? But there are still Tang Clan members—”
hunks.sol: “E-Everyone? But there are still Tang Clan bastards—”

hunks.baseline: “Those bastards aren’t the problem. Hurry!”
hunks.sol: “They’re not the problem. Hurry!”

hunks.baseline: The subordinate, frozen stiff, pulled a firework from inside his clothes and lit it. With a pop, a red streak of light burst in the air.
hunks.sol: The terrified subordinate pulled a signal flare from inside his clothes and triggered it. With a pop, a streak of red light burst across the sky.

hunks.baseline: At the emergency signal, the black-clad men scattered throughout the Sichuan Tang Clan began gathering one after another.
hunks.sol: At the emergency signal, the black-clad men scattered throughout the Sichuan Tang Clan began converging on the area.

hunks.baseline: A group numbering well over a hundred assembled only a brief instant later.
hunks.sol: Within moments, well over a hundred had assembled.

hunks.baseline: “Deputy Captain. Please give us your orders.”
hunks.sol: “Deputy Captain. Give us your orders.”

hunks.baseline: The deputy captain wanted to smash the skull of the man who had just spoken. The First Captain, First Fiend, was likewise nowhere to be seen, despite the emergency signal.
hunks.sol: The deputy captain wanted to smash in the skull of the man who had just spoken. The same went for their captain, First Fiend, who had yet to show so much as a hair despite the emergency signal.

hunks.baseline: The deputy captain’s throat bobbed heavily as he stared at the cliff, which was still collapsing.
hunks.sol: The deputy captain’s throat bobbed as he stared at the still-collapsing cliff.

hunks.sol: The order he was about to give was tantamount to suicide. He was going to send them beneath a collapsing cliff to search for the Western Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.sol: Just as he struggled to finish—

hunks.sol: Crash! Thud-thud-thud!

hunks.baseline: Fresh air and rainwater seeped in through his nose and mouth.
hunks.sol: Fresh air and rainwater filled his nose and mouth.

hunks.baseline: The refreshing sensation felt as if it were washing even his soul clean. His internal energy was already exhausted, and his body felt as though it had been smashed to pieces, but Jeok Cheongang smiled with relief at having rescued Jin Taekyung.
hunks.sol: The sensation was so refreshing it seemed to wash his very soul clean. His internal energy was exhausted, and his body felt ready to fall apart, but Jeok Cheongang smiled in relief.

hunks.baseline: Then, in the next instant, he staggeringly raised his upper body—and froze.
hunks.sol: Then he staggered upright—and froze.

hunks.sol: A group stood a little over twenty zhang away, staring at him.

hunks.baseline: There were well over a hundred black-clad men, all holding bloodstained weapons.
hunks.sol: Well over a hundred men dressed in black, all holding bloodstained weapons.

hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang groaned under his breath.

hunks.baseline: “……Goddamn it. No matter how I look at them, they don’t seem like good people.”
hunks.sol: “…Goddamn it. No matter how I look at them, they don’t seem like good people.”

hunks.baseline: A reply came that turned his guess into certainty.
hunks.sol: A voice behind him confirmed his suspicion.

hunks.baseline: “They are called Dark Heaven.”
hunks.sol: “They call themselves Dark Heaven.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang was not surprised even when the voice suddenly came from behind him.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang was not startled by the unexpected voice.

hunks.baseline: He had endured every kind of hardship, and he had only just escaped the threat of being crushed to death. He had known from the changed breathing that the unknown old man he had saved had awakened.
hunks.sol: He had been through every manner of hardship and had just escaped being crushed to death. He had already noticed from the change in his breathing that the unknown old man he had rescued was awake.

hunks.baseline: “I see. Dark Heaven. I knew it was those sons of bitches.”
hunks.sol: “I see. Dark Heaven. I knew it had to be those sons of bitches.”

hunks.baseline: After muttering a curse, Jeok Cheongang continued without turning around.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang continued without looking back.

hunks.baseline: “This is the Sichuan Tang Clan. Unfortunately, it appears the battle has already been decided.”
hunks.sol: “The Sichuan Tang Clan. Regrettably, it appears the battle has already been decided.”

hunks.baseline: “……This is driving me crazy.”
hunks.sol: “…This is driving me insane.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang ended his assessment with that short sentence.
hunks.sol: That brief remark summed up Jeok Cheongang’s feelings.

hunks.baseline: He did not have much time to wonder how this had happened.
hunks.sol: He did not have enough time to wonder how any of this had happened.

hunks.baseline: “Do you have a sobriquet?”
hunks.sol: “Your sobriquet?”

hunks.sol: “I am not a martial artist, so naturally I have none.”

hunks.baseline: “Your dantian was damaged. You’re not a martial artist?”
hunks.sol: “Your dantian was destroyed, yet you claim you aren’t a martial artist?”

hunks.baseline: “It was only a little training I picked up because my Master pestered me into it. Medicine was where my heart lay.”
hunks.sol: “I only learned a little because my Master would not stop pestering me. Medicine was always where my heart lay.”

hunks.baseline: Even though he had suffered a serious injury, the old man’s calm manner and speech carried an air of wisdom. Why did Jeok Cheongang suddenly think of a physician whose medical arts were said to have reached divine heights?
hunks.sol: Despite his severe injuries, the old man’s calm bearing and manner of speech carried an unmistakable air of wisdom. Why did they remind Jeok Cheongang of a physician whose medical arts were said to have reached the divine realm?

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang let out a hollow laugh at the Divine Physician’s answer. He finally felt as though he understood what had happened.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang let out a hollow laugh at the Divine Physician’s answer. At last, he thought he understood what had happened.

hunks.baseline: “Thank you. For waking this old man who was nearly dead.”
hunks.sol: “Thank you for waking an old man who was at death’s door.”

hunks.baseline: “You rose on your own. That was how strong your will was, Sir Jeok.”
hunks.sol: “You awakened on your own. Your will was simply that strong, Sir Jeok.”

hunks.sol: “I had no choice. Some reckless fool woke me up.”

hunks.baseline: “That very reckless fool crossed the Central Plains to find me and asked me to help. He said he would do anything if I could save you, Sir Jeok.”
hunks.sol: “That very reckless fool crossed the Central Plains to find me and begged for my help. He said he would do anything if it meant saving you, Sir Jeok.”

hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang turned his head. Jin Taekyung lay collapsed beside him, covered in blood and mud.

hunks.baseline: “……What a foolish boy.”
hunks.sol: “…What a foolish boy.”

hunks.baseline: If only he could wake that child right now, he wanted to wake him.
hunks.sol: If he could wake the boy now, he would.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps they could have one final conversation.
hunks.sol: Perhaps then they could have one final conversation.

hunks.baseline: But Jin Taekyung had exhausted every bit of his strength. He would not be able to rise. Even without the Divine Physician telling him, Jeok Cheongang knew that much.
hunks.sol: But Jin Taekyung had exhausted every last ounce of strength. He would not awaken. Jeok Cheongang knew that even without the Divine Physician telling him.

hunks.baseline: *Yes. Perhaps… perhaps this is for the best.*
hunks.sol: *Yes. Perhaps… this is better.*

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang slowly rose to his feet. Ignoring the pain stabbing through his entire body, he spoke toward the Divine Physician behind him.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang slowly rose to his feet. Ignoring the pain stabbing through his entire body, he addressed the Divine Physician behind him.

hunks.baseline: “Got any strength in you?”
hunks.sol: “Still have any strength left?”

hunks.baseline: “I could in my younger days. Before I met my Master, I worked as a carpenter.”
hunks.sol: “I did in my younger days. Before meeting my Master, I worked as a carpenter.”

hunks.baseline: “Your dantian is damaged, so it won’t be easy, but squeeze out every last bit of strength you have. Run as far away as possible.”
hunks.sol: “Your dantian is damaged, so it won’t be easy, but squeeze out every last bit of strength you have. Run as far away as you can.”

hunks.baseline: A faint smile appeared at the corner of Jeok Cheongang’s mouth. His gaze slowly turned toward the approaching black-clad men.
hunks.sol: A faint smile touched the corner of Jeok Cheongang’s mouth. His gaze settled on the approaching men in black.

hunks.baseline: “Do you know why a flame dies out?”
hunks.sol: “Do you know why a flame dies?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang did not wait for the Divine Physician’s answer.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang did not wait for an answer.

hunks.baseline: With each step he took, muddy water splashed. The rain that had seemed as though it would fall forever had stopped at some point.
hunks.sol: Muddy water splashed beneath his advancing feet. At some point, the rain that had seemed as if it would never end had stopped.

hunks.baseline: His voice continued, refreshed and unburdened.
hunks.sol: His voice rang out, clear and unburdened.

hunks.baseline: “Because there is nothing left to burn. That is why it slowly dies out atop the ashes.”
hunks.sol: “Because it has nothing left to burn. So it slowly dies among the ashes.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had finished preparing to kindle his final flame.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang was ready to kindle his final flame.

hunks.baseline: He felt no fear or anger toward the death approaching him.
hunks.sol: He felt neither fear nor anger at the death striding toward him.
Only regret.

hunks.baseline: He only felt regret. He would no longer be able to remain at his Disciple’s side.
hunks.sol: He would no longer be able to remain by his Disciple’s side.

hunks.baseline: “I’m leaving Taekyung in your care.”
hunks.sol: “Take care of Taekyung for me.”

hunks.sol: Just as Jeok Cheongang stepped forward after making that heartfelt request, the Divine Physician spoke.

hunks.sol: “After witnessing countless births, aging, sickness, and deaths, I began to wonder. Does the underworld truly exist? If so, who is this fellow called Yama? And if I go there, will I meet the patients I failed to save?”

hunks.baseline: “Whenever I asked myself that, my Master would tell me this: ‘The underworld must be full because of all the people you sent ahead. You should ascend to the celestial realm and spend your days with the immortals.’”
hunks.sol: “Whenever such questions troubled me, my Master would say, ‘The underworld must be full from all the people you sent ahead of you. You should ascend to the celestial realm instead and keep the immortals company.’”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician looked at Jeok Cheongang as he spoke in a quiet voice.
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician looked at Jeok Cheongang and continued quietly.

hunks.sol: Every hair on Jeok Cheongang’s body stood on end. His head snapped up.

hunks.baseline: High in the sky, a boy stood bathed in sunlight streaming through a break in the retreating dark clouds.
hunks.sol: High above, bathed in sunlight streaming between the retreating dark clouds, stood a boy.

hunks.baseline: *No. That isn’t right. That man is…!*
hunks.sol: *No. Not a boy. That man is…!*

hunks.baseline: Those eyes were clear and bright like a boy’s, yet the gaze itself was ancient and seasoned, betraying no emotion whatsoever.
hunks.sol: His eyes were clear and bright like a boy’s, yet ancient and seasoned, devoid of the slightest emotion.

hunks.baseline: Eyes Jeok Cheongang had encountered only once, a very long time ago. That was why the sensation was all the more impossible to forget.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had seen those eyes only once, a very long time ago.
That was precisely why he could never forget the feeling they evoked.

hunks.baseline: Remembering someone from the boy’s appearance, Jeok Cheongang cried out in shock.
hunks.sol: The boy’s appearance brought someone to mind, and Jeok Cheongang cried out in shock.
